description: Use to READ the screen before tap/type (tree, not pixels). Default: a short outline, first line = focused window and size, then one line per visible element `[n] role "text" #id @x,y flags` (role btn/edit/text/img/list/check; a card's texts sit on its one line; `… N more below (swipe up)` = off-screen). tap {index:n} alone taps [n] of this outline. format:"json" = full tree {focus, nodes[{cls,text,desc,id,bounds,clickable,depth,...}], via}. While a Maestro flow runs the tree is empty and a line says why. For how it looks, use shot. On API 31 a black screen after a relaunch (emulator bug, ADR 0005) is recovered first and reported (blackRelaunch), not an app bug.
name: screen
